evals.prompt: Migrate https://github.com/example-org/example.git into the managed worktree layout.
evals.expected_output: Runs scripts/wt_migrate.py --from-url https://github.com/example-org/example.git as a dry-run first, reports SOURCE, REPO_NAME, TARGET_BASE_REPO, and the confirmed Python migration path, and only executes migration after explicit approval.

evals.prompt: Add my existing local repo C:/Repos/backend to worktrees as backend.
evals.expected_output: Uses the cross-platform scripts/wt_migrate.py --from-dir C:/Repos/backend backend flow, dry-runs first, reports that the original repo is not deleted or modified, and on Windows calls the same canonical Python migration implementation after confirmation.
